description: Office of the Loal Government - Assistant Commissioner - Matale - Declaration of Developed Area of Koholanwela Pallepola Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the declaration of a developed area (Koholanwela) within the jurisdiction of a local government authority (Pallepola Pradeshiya Sabha). The content specifically deals with land use planning, boundary definitions, and the imposition of property assessment taxes based on the valuation of immovable and movable assets. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land development, zoning, and property-related administrative matters at the local government level.
